name: EMA-CO (Etoposide/Methotrexate/Dactinomycin - Cyclophosphamide/Vincristine) for High-Risk GTN
cyclesNote: repeat every 2 weeks (EMA on days 1 to 2, CO on day 8) until hCG normalizes, then continue for an additional 6 to 8 weeks (consolidation); physician determined

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: High risk GTN is a clinical/staging category (prognostic score 7 or higher, or FIGO stage IV, or stage I to III with score greater than 6), not a molecular biomarker gate. EMA-CO is the preferred primary multiagent regimen for high risk disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia v2.2026, High-Risk GTN Primary Therapy Options (GTN-D).

treatmentSetting: curative-intent primary therapy for high-risk GTN

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: multiagent regimen; give antiemetic prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

supportiveCare: leucovorin (folinic acid) rescue is part of the regimen for the methotrexate component.
G-CSF (filgrastim 5 mcg/kg on days 4 to 6(7) and 10 to 12(13) of each cycle) for secondary prophylaxis of neutropenic fever or treatment delay, to maintain dose intensity (NCCN GTN-D 2 of 7).
verify adequate renal function before the methotrexate dose.
for brain metastases: intensify methotrexate to 1000 mg/m2 over 24 hours and extend leucovorin rescue (NCCN).
monitoring: serum hCG each cycle (response and remission tracking)
CBC before each treatment day (day 1 and day 8)
renal function before the methotrexate dose

doseModificationRules.text: Hard per-dose cap of 2 mg (source stated maximum). Never exceed; never administer intrathecally.
Use filgrastim per NCCN to maintain the every 2 week dose intensity; delay per institutional protocol if counts inadequate.

doseModificationRules.condition: resistance to EMA-CO (plateau or re-elevation of hCG)
doseModificationRules.text: Switch to a platinum containing salvage regimen (EMA-EP / EP-EMA) per source; clinical review required.

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. Etoposide 100 mg/m2/day IV over 60 minutes on days 1 and 2 (the EMA component). DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 prints etoposide 100 mg/m2 over 30 minutes on days 1 and 2 (same dose, shorter infusion).

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Etoposide 100 mg/m2/day IV over 60 minutes on Days 1 and 2

drugs.name: Dactinomycin (actinomycin-D)
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. Dactinomycin (actinomycin-D) 0.5 mg fixed dose IV push on days 1 and 2. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 prints the identical 0.5 mg IV push on days 1 and 2.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Dactinomycin 0.5 mg IV Push on Days 1 and 2

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. Methotrexate 300 mg/m2 IV infusion over 12 hours on day 1, with leucovorin rescue. DIVERGENCE: DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 delivers the same total as a 100 mg/m2 IV push plus 200 mg/m2 over 12 hours (see evidence.divergence). For brain metastases the source increases the methotrexate infusion to 1000 mg/m2 over 24 hours (NCCN GTN-D 2 of 7). Requires adequate renal function and mandatory leucovorin rescue.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Methotrexate 300 mg/m2 IV infusion over 12 hours on Day 1

drugs.name: Leucovorin (folinic acid)
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. Leucovorin rescue 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM every 12 hours for 4 doses, starting 24 hours after the start of the methotrexate infusion (begins on day 2). Mandatory rescue for the methotrexate component. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 prints the identical 15 mg every 12 hours x 4 doses IM or PO beginning 24 hours after starting methotrexate. For brain metastases, leucovorin is intensified to 15 mg every 6 hours for 12 doses starting 32 hours after the methotrexate infusion (NCCN).

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Leucovorin 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM every 12 hours for 4 doses starting 24 hours after the start of the methotrexate infusion

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV over 30 minutes on day 8 (the CO component). DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 prints the identical 600 mg/m2 over 30 minutes on day 8.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV over 30 minutes on Day 8

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 2 of 7. vinCRIStine 0.8 mg/m2 IV over 5 to 10 minutes on day 8, with a hard per-dose cap of 2 mg (source stated maximum). DIVERGENCE: DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.3 prints vincristine 1.0 mg/m2 on day 8 (no cap printed); the authored value uses the more current NCCN 0.8 mg/m2 with the explicit 2 mg cap (see evidence.divergence). Tall man per ISMP. Vesicant, IV only, never intrathecal.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 2 of 7, EMA-CO: Vincristine 0.8 mg/m2 (maximum of 2 mg) IV over 5 to 10 minutes on Day 8
